accepted_gap_recorded.reason: Accepted gaps need one owner/reason/review-date/downstream-risk shape across requirements and architecture.

automation_manual_stability_present.reason: Automation promotion is governed by Codex workflow maturity and consumed by release operations.

bounded_context_architecture_boundary_tr.reason: Bounded-context traceability is an architecture boundary decision consumed by domain requirements.

external_write_approval_present.reason: External mutation approval is a security/privacy boundary consumed by API and integration work.

CHANGELOG.md.reason: Changelog is usually a project artifact; Product-Agent OS packages release notes and release readiness templates instead.

SKILL.md.reason: Skill manifests live inside checked-in skill directories rather than staged project artifact templates.

handoff-contract.md.reason: The canonical handoff contract is packaged as a lifecycle skill reference and consumed by agent-task-packet.md.

plugin-blueprint.md.reason: Plugin blueprint lives under docs/artifact-templates for plugin design, not as a generated target-project template.

priority_tie_breakers.reason: Approval boundaries outrank generic quality strategy when external write, payment, release or production data risk exists.
Security-sensitive or payment work needs owner review before generic quality planning.
Publish, deploy and package release claims need release readiness evidence before generic quality planning.
Generic quality strategy remains visible but should not hide a specific high-risk owner action.

conflict_rules.reason: FSD-like backend folders are not sufficient evidence for frontend blockers.
CI or release files alone are present_unverified until publish, deploy, secret, external-write or user-impact evidence exists.
